s2.ptxt: Remove the 9 clips and the radiator upper air deflector.
Place both hands on the front of the cover and lift it upward to disengage the 2 front clips, then continue lifting upward to disengage the 1 rear clips, and remove the V-bank cover.

atten3.ptxt: Pulling up the front and rear at the same time may cause damage.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Engine Mounting Stay NO.2 RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and 2 nuts, and remove engine mounting stay NO.2 RH.
Remove the 2 bolts and disconnect the radiator reserve tank assembly.

atten4.ptxt: Without disconnecting the hoses, suspend the radiator reserve tank assembly from the body with a string or similar.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Engine Under Cover Rear RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 5 clips and the engine under cover rear RH.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Engine Mounting Insulator Sub-assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and 2 clamps, and disconnect the ground wire.
Remove the 2 bolts and nut, and remove the cooler pipe bracket.
Support the engine assembly with a transmission jack using a wooden block or similar.
Remove the 2 bolts and 2 nuts, and disconnect the engine mounting insulator RH from the engine mounting bracket RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Engine Mounting Insulator Sub-assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 3 bolts and remove the engine mounting insulator RH.
